description: Utility functions for throughput data processing, including data rate formatting, calculation, timestamp formatting, chart data preparation, and unit conversions.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts bytes per second to a human-readable data rate with appropriate units.

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates current data rate (rx and tx) from cumulative byte counts and previous values.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into HH:MM:SS string for chart labels.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares chart data series from time series throughput data, including labels and datasets.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the appropriate unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for the y-axis based on maximum data rate.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts data rate from bytes per second to a specified unit for display.
